auth.note: Reads work without a key at a lower limit; a key raises it to your plan.

function.name: chord_chains
function.description: The chains Chord serves, with their native asset, anchors and which capabilities each one has (overview, tokens, trades, candles, wallet PnL, smart money, holders, LP, quote, swap). Call this first when unsure what a chain supports.

function.name: chord_status
function.description: Live health of every chain: routing engine state, how old the newest indexed trade is, and the public status page link.

function.name: chord_overview
function.description: A chain's last 24 hours on the venues Chord indexes: volume, swaps, venue share, hourly buckets.

chain.description: Chain key. chord_chains lists what each chain supports.

function.name: chord_tokens
function.description: The chain's 24h token board: price, volume, trades, change. Sort names differ by chain; a wrong one is answered with the allowed list.

chain.description: Chain key. chord_chains lists what each chain supports.

sort.description: Board order, e.g. volume, trades, change.

function.name: chord_search
function.description: Find a token on one chain by symbol, name or address. Returns candidates with their addresses; similar tickers are common, so compare addresses.

chain.description: Chain key. chord_chains lists what each chain supports.

function.name: chord_token
function.description: One token on one chain: price, 24h volume and trades, pools or venues, and what the index knows about it.

chain.description: Chain key. chord_chains lists what each chain supports.

address.description: Token address: 0x… on EVM chains, the base58 mint on Solana (case-sensitive).

function.name: chord_trades
function.description: The newest swaps of a token, with side, size in USD, price, venue and the wallet where it is known.

chain.description: Chain key. chord_chains lists what each chain supports.

address.description: Token address: 0x… on EVM chains, the base58 mint on Solana (case-sensitive).

function.name: chord_candles
function.description: OHLCV candles of a token from Chord's own index.

chain.description: Chain key. chord_chains lists what each chain supports.

address.description: Token address: 0x… on EVM chains, the base58 mint on Solana (case-sensitive).

function.name: chord_wallet
function.description: A wallet's trading result on one chain: realised and open PnL per token. Windows differ by chain and are stated in the answer.

chain.description: Chain key. chord_chains lists what each chain supports.

wallet.description: Wallet address: 0x… on EVM chains, base58 on Solana.

function.name: chord_wallet_trades
function.description: A wallet's recent swaps on one chain. Not every chain has this; chord_chains says which.

chain.description: Chain key. chord_chains lists what each chain supports.

wallet.description: Wallet address: 0x… on EVM chains, base58 on Solana.

function.name: chord_smart_money
function.description: Wallets ranked by profit on one chain, bots removed. Not every chain has this board.

chain.description: Chain key. chord_chains lists what each chain supports.

days.description: Window in days (default 7). Solana has 1, 3, 7; EVM boards have 1, 7, 30.

function.name: chord_holders
function.description: Holder ledger of a token (balances by address) on the chains that keep one.

chain.description: Chain key. chord_chains lists what each chain supports.

address.description: Token address: 0x… on EVM chains, the base58 mint on Solana (case-sensitive).

function.name: chord_lp_pools
function.description: Pools ranked for a liquidity provider: volume, fees, TVL, fee/TVL.

chain.description: Chain key. chord_chains lists what each chain supports.

function.name: chord_lp_positions
function.description: A wallet's liquidity positions on one chain: range, value, fees, in or out of range.

chain.description: Chain key. chord_chains lists what each chain supports.

wallet.description: Wallet address: 0x… on EVM chains, base58 on Solana.

function.name: chord_quote
function.description: Best swap quote on an EVM chain. Chord's own router answers first; another aggregator only when Chord cannot route. Amounts are integer strings in the token's smallest unit; the zero address is the native asset. Returns a quoteId valid for 2 minutes.

chain.description: EVM chain key. Solana swaps are REST only: GET /v1/sol/trade/quote.

tokenIn.description: Token address: 0x… on EVM chains, the base58 mint on Solana (case-sensitive).

tokenOut.description: Token address: 0x… on EVM chains, the base58 mint on Solana (case-sensitive).

amount.description: Input amount in the smallest unit, digits only.

taker.description: Optional: the wallet that will sign. With it the answer includes the transaction and a simulation.

function.name: chord_swap_tx
function.description: The UNSIGNED transaction for a swap, plus the approval it needs and a simulation run as the taker. Nothing is sent: the taker's own wallet signs and broadcasts. Pass a quoteId from chord_quote, or the full parameters.

chain.description: EVM chain key. Solana swaps are REST only: GET /v1/sol/trade/quote.

tokenIn.description: Token address: 0x… on EVM chains, the base58 mint on Solana (case-sensitive).

tokenOut.description: Token address: 0x… on EVM chains, the base58 mint on Solana (case-sensitive).

taker.description: The wallet that signs and receives.

function.name: chord_ask
function.description: Ask Chord's analyst a question in plain language (markets, tokens, wallets, perps, macro). Uses many data sources and takes 10 to 60 seconds. Needs an API key.
